header.name: Robot going for a stroll V10
header.description: Play: five limbs from the body (the hinged left arm, the banana arm, a waving arm from the back, two long legs). Each has a hinge cap. The arms swing and fold, the tail whips down its length, the antenna bounces on its spring, the eyelids blink twice a lap and the body bounces on each step. Path from Quick Detail "Robot Path 2" (fd1878e1-ac12-4355-afee-3ebeeb07d4d9).
